method: Per-vault classification of who can change the vault and how fast: immutable, timelocked multisig (strong means a 3+ threshold and a majority of signers), multisig only, or a single admin key scored by the curator track record (40 established, 10 unknown or new, floor 10); protocols without a per-vault admin layer (Aave, Pendle, EtherFi, Ethena) and BNB vaults are not screened and stay on protocol metadata.
